name: context-menu
title: Context Menu
description: A right-click menu that opens at the cursor over a file card, then an item is hovered, pressed and the menu closes.
useWhen: Showing a right-click menu appearing at a cursor position over content in a product demo.
Demonstrating browser-like or OS-like contextual actions (Back, Reload, Inspect).
A cursor scene needs a pop-up menu that originates from a click point, not a button.
avoidWhen: The menu is opened from a button in the UI: use dropdown-menu.
The overlay is a searchable command palette: use command-menu.
The overlay is a modal that blocks the scene: use dialog or alert-dialog.
author: Remocn

variables.label: File name
variables.description: Label on the card that gets right-clicked.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed of the scripted interaction. 2 plays it twice as fast and holds the end.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the control sits over your own scene.
